# Mermaid 12.2.0

`mermaid.min.js` from the npm package `mermaid@12.2.0` (MIT, see `LICENSE`), unchanged. It draws the Mermaid diagrams a model
writes in the chat: inside the VS Code chat page, and in a headless Edge for Visual Studio. Nothing is fetched at run time.
To update it, replace the file with the `dist/mermaid.min.js` of a newer release and change the version here.
